**[[Israel–Netherlands relations]]
***A [[Criminal justice system of the Netherlands|Dutch appeals court]] orders a suspension of exports of [[Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II|F-35 jet]] parts to Israel within the next seven days over concerns that the aircraft parts are being used to commit [[Israeli war crimes|serious violations of international humanitarian law]]. [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] says that the government will appeal the suspension. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/dutch-court-orders-halt-export-f-35-jet-parts-israel-2024-02-12/ (Reuters)]
